name: Auto-compact
description: Sends /compact by itself to a Claude that waits at its prompt with its context past a mark, after a countdown you can cancel.
author: Otterm

settings.label: Compact when the context is past
settings.help: Only while Claude waits at its prompt, between turns. With the context warning off, the first choice never compacts.

settings.label: Countdown
settings.help: How long it waits, showing a Cancel in the pane header and the sidebar row, before it sends /compact.
